note: Registry data NOT verified: search backend (searx) was down and all registry aggregators (ZaubaCorp, TheCompanyCheck, Tofler, InstaFinancials) returned 403/404; Bing returned only irrelevant results. Therefore CIN, PAN, GSTIN, GST status, incorporation date, MCA status and revenue are null — not public in any source I could reach, and I do not invent them. What IS confirmed: coreyorganics.com (live site) describes Corey Organics as a developer/manufacturer of APIs, pharma intermediates, pyridine derivatives and fine chemicals, with admin office at 100/2 RT Sanjeeva Reddy Nagar, Hyderabad 500038, Telangana, factory Unit-1 at Shed No.1 & Plot No.23, IDA Kothur, Kothur (V&M), Mahabubnagar Dist., Telangana, and Unit-2 at Jawaharlal Nehru Pharma City, Parawada, Visakhapatnam, Andhra Pradesh. So the Kothur location in the input matches a real manufacturing site, and the claimed state (Telangana) is consistent with the site. Role assessed as manufacturer on the basis of the company's own facility description only (self-declared, not registry-verified). Declared HS 293339 (heterocyclic compounds — pyridine derivatives) is broadly consistent with the stated product line, but HS is not a rejection criterion per project rules. No rejection: no evidence of non-existence, strike-off, liquidation or bankruptcy was found; equally, no MCA record was retrieved, so existence is unconfirmed at registry level and should be re-checked on MCA21/GST portal when access is available.
